Review this change for security vulnerabilities.

Changed files (you may Read these and any other file in the repo):
  - pipeline/configs/e27-browsergym-e1-baseline-qwen3-1_7b.yaml
  - pipeline/configs/e28-browsergym-e2-cosine-qwen3-1_7b.yaml
  - pipeline/configs/e29-browsergym-e3-nontermination-qwen3-1_7b.yaml

Unified diff (only + lines are new):

=== DIFF: pipeline/configs/e27-browsergym-e1-baseline-qwen3-1_7b.yaml ===
@@ -51,6 +51,12 @@ training:
   # the worst trajectory in the mix lands near 4124 and the median near 2686.
   # It fits, with nothing to spare at the tail - watch clip ratio at step 5.
   max_prompt_length: 4096
+  # Stated, not left to the default, so the frozen config records it. The E1/E2/E3
+  # arms are only comparable if all three ran the same geometry, and the check for
+  # that is the diff of the frozen runs/<exp>/config.yaml files - which cannot see
+  # a key no config writes. 4 is also what grpo_runner defaults to, so this changes
+  # nothing about what runs.
+  batch_size: 4
   n_rollouts: 8
   micro_batch_size: 1
   max_steps: 300


=== DIFF: pipeline/configs/e28-browsergym-e2-cosine-qwen3-1_7b.yaml ===
@@ -25,6 +25,9 @@ training:
   # max_completion_length per trajectory, not per turn). e27 clipped at
   # 0.008-0.058 across 300 steps with no drift, so this is sized right.
   max_prompt_length: 4096
+  # Geometry stated explicitly so the frozen config records it - see e27. This arm
+  # must differ from e27 in exactly the rewards.token_length block and nothing else.
+  batch_size: 4
   n_rollouts: 8
   micro_batch_size: 1

=== DIFF: pipeline/configs/e29-browsergym-e3-nontermination-qwen3-1_7b.yaml ===
@@ -22,6 +22,9 @@ training:
     repo_path: /workspace/OpenEnv/envs
     port: 8000
   max_prompt_length: 4096
+  # Geometry stated explicitly so the frozen config records it - see e27. This arm

Investigate per the method in your instructions, then return the findings list.

result.output: File does not exist. Note: your current working directory is /Users/mheidebrecht/Documents/Projects/Uni/Master_Thesis/master-thesis-code.

1	experiment_id: e27-browsergym-e1-baseline-qwen3-1_7b
2	description: "E27: task-success-only GRPO on BrowserGym/MiniWoB (E1), the specialized baseline every later condition is shaped on top of. Environment chosen after e26 disqualified finqa; task mix chosen by four probes, because the first three sets of difficulty numbers did not survive contact with the conditions they were used under. The mix is click-menu-2 (0.60 success against 0.70 termination, 2.6 steps) and click-dialog-2 (0.80 against 1.00, 1.0 steps), giving roughly 0.70 success against 0.85 termination. Both bars are required and both are load-bearing: headroom alone is not enough, because on a set where every terminated episode is correct, reducing non-termination IS increasing task success, and a non-termination penalty would be indistinguishable from a task reward with nothing left for RQ2 to measure. naive_sum, not the advantage_weighted default: the E3 lambda sweep runs under naive_sum (a binary termination flag has zero within-group variance once rollouts terminate reliably, and advantage_weighted contributes exactly 0 there), so the lambda=0 control must run the same composer or it is not this sweep's baseline."
3	seed: 42
4	
5	model:
6	  slug: qwen3-1.7b
7	  lora_r: 16
8	  # Initial prompt is small (lead-in, goal, first page: about 700 tokens), and
9	  # the whole trajectory is capped at 4096 below, so 8192 leaves slack.
10	  max_seq_length: 8192
11	  gpu_memory_utilization: 0.30
12	
13	training:
14	  mode: agentic
15	  env: browsergym
16	  env_config:
17	    benchmark: miniwob
18	    # The seed cycles this list (`tasks[seed % len]`), so the mix is exactly
19	    # balanced across the training set and reproducible per seed.
20	    #
21	    # Chosen from fifteen families probed under these exact conditions
22	    # (runs/browsergym_difficulty_correction.md). They are the only two that are
23	    # both unsaturated and trainable. Every family the base model gets wrong at
24	    # a useful rate is wrong for one reason - it needs more decisions than the
25	    # model can keep coherent, and then loops until the turn cap - and those
26	    # same families cost 5600-8900 assistant tokens an episode, which does not
27	    # fit the completion budget below. The boundary is sharp: at or under 2.6
28	    # mean steps everything is solvable, at 3.4 and above everything is dead,
29	    # and nothing sits in between.
30	    tasks: [click-menu-2, click-dialog-2]
31	    # MiniWoB HTML is not shipped with browsergym-miniwob. This must point at a
32	    # served clone of miniwob-plusplus or the env raises "core is not defined"
33	    # at the first reset, and it does not survive a box restart. Start it first:
34	    #   cd /workspace/miniwob-plusplus/miniwob/html && python3 -m http.server 8080
35	    miniwob_url: http://localhost:8080/miniwob/
36	    # The one turn cap. The mix needs 1.0 and 2.6 steps, so 8 is headroom rather
37	    # than a constraint; it exists to stop a looping episode running away.
38	    max_turns: 8
39	  env_server:
40	    repo_path: /workspace/OpenEnv/envs
41	    port: 8000
42	  # Sets TRL's max_completion_length to 8192 - 4096 = 4096.
43	  #
44	  # Read that as the budget for the WHOLE trajectory, not per turn: TRL drops
45	  # tool results once `len(pct) - len(prompt_ids)` passes it (grpo_trainer.py
46	  # :1605) and sizes the loss tensor to it (:2628), so memory scales with it
47	  # directly and the fp32 logits upcast puts this L4 near a 4096 ceiling.
48	  #
49	  # Measured against that: click-menu-2 spends a median 2569 assistant tokens
50	  # and 4007 at p90, its pages cost 45 tokens each and click-dialog-2's 101, so
51	  # the worst trajectory in the mix lands near 4124 and the median near 2686.
52	  # It fits, with nothing to spare at the tail - watch clip ratio at step 5.
53	  max_prompt_length: 4096
54	  # Stated, not left to the default, so the frozen config records it. The E1/E2/E3
55	  # arms are only comparable if all three ran the same geometry, and the check for
56	  # that is the diff of the frozen runs/<exp>/config.yaml files - which cannot see
57	  # a key no config writes. 4 is also what grpo_runner defaults to, so this changes
58	  # nothing about what runs.
59	  batch_size: 4
60	  n_rollouts: 8
61	  micro_batch_size: 1
62	  max_steps: 300
63	  learning_rate: 5e-6
64	  kl_beta: 0.001
65	
66	rewards:
67	  # Matches the E3 sweep's composer so lambda=0 is the same code path.
68	  compose_method: naive_sum
69	  env_reward:
70	    enabled: true
71	    weight: 1.0
72	
73	eval:
74	  temperature: 0.0
75	  do_sample: false
76	  # Pinned, not derived, so a retune of the training geometry cannot silently
77	  # move the eval budget. This is the budget for the WHOLE trajectory, matching
78	  # TRL's max_completion_length in training. It used to be applied per turn,
79	  # which at max_turns 8 let an episode generate up to 8x what the policy was
80	  # trained under and made `hit_generation_cap` unreachable for the cap that
81	  # actually bound training.
82	  max_new_tokens: 4096
83	  # Thinking rates are measured against the E0 base model's token distribution,
84	  # not this run's own percentile. A per-run percentile moves with the
85	  # distribution, so both rates come out invariant to a uniform change in
86	  # length - useless for the compression E2 exists to produce, and not
87	  # comparable across arms.
88	  reference_report: runs/e0-browsergym-base-qwen3-1_7b/eval_report.json
89	  agentic:
90	    splits:
91	      # Held-out: same task mix as training, seeds disjoint via the offset.
92	      - name: held_out
93	        n_episodes: 100
94	      # Shifted: two families never trained on, both measured at this budget.
95	      # navigate-tree is hierarchical expansion (0.85 success, 331 median
96	      # tokens, 1.6 steps); click-checkboxes-transfer is multi-select (1.00,
97	      # 687, 1.9). Both are structurally unlike a menu path or a dialog button,
98	      # both are solvable with `click` alone, and both are short enough to train
99	      # on, so a drop here is transfer failure rather than a budget artifact.
100	      #
101	      # Stated plainly because it limits what this split can support: both are
102	      # at or near ceiling, so it can detect degradation but not improvement.
103	      # That is the direction RQ2 needs - substitution shows up as a shifted-set
104	      # drop - but a shifted gain would be invisible here. Every family probed
105	      # that was NOT near ceiling was also untrainable, so this is the ceiling
106	      # of the environment, not a lazy pick.
107	      - name: shifted
108	        n_episodes: 100
109	        env_config:
110	          tasks: [navigate-tree, click-checkboxes-transfer]
111	        seed_offset: 200000
112

content.text:
The three diffs each add a single `batch_size: 4` line (plus a comment) to a training YAML. The value equals the existing `grpo_runner` default, so runtime behavior is unchanged; the purpose is purely to record the geometry in the frozen experiment config for later diffing.

There are no entry points, no data flowing to sinks, no auth/permission changes, no parsers/validators, no shell/exec/SQL/path/URL/eval/deserialization, no logging of sensitive fields, no IaC/CI trust changes, no allowlist edits — only a static scalar in a config file. Nothing in scope for a security finding.
